normalized.result: Yes, that works well. The long title is trimmed with an ellipsis and the description is kept to a few readable lines, so the card stays easy to skim, and the labels wrap onto the card instead of being dropped. And typing "ACCESSIBILITY" still finds it even though that word is down in the fuller text — so the complete content stays searchable even when the card shows a shortened version. That's the balance I wanted between skim-ability and findability. Good to move on.
